proposed_comments.title: Preserve empty JSON files and propagate final retry failures
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve empty JSON files and propagate final retry failures

**Severity:** `medium`

`JsonFile.Restore()` currently treats an originally empty file the same as a file that did not exist, so cleanup can delete a user's empty fixture instead of restoring it. The retry helper also reports success after all retry attempts fail. Please use `null` as the only missing-file sentinel and let the final `IOException` or `UnauthorizedAccessException` propagate so stale test state cannot be silently accepted.

proposed_comments.title: Restore FancyZones module settings after tests
proposed_comments.body:
### Restore FancyZones module settings after tests

**Severity:** `high`

The new FancyZones tests snapshot and restore layout data files, but every scenario mutates `FancyZones/settings.json` through `FancyZonesSettingsSeed.Apply()`. That leaks module settings between focused runs and can leave a developer's local profile changed after the suite. Please include `settings.json` in the `FancyZonesFiles` snapshot and restore it with the other FancyZones files.

proposed_comments.title: Query the hotkey popup through the editor process
proposed_comments.body:
### Query the hotkey popup through the editor process

**Severity:** `medium`

`DeleteLayoutWithHotkey` opens the same hotkey ComboBox popup that other tests query through a process-scoped FancyZones Editor session, because the popup is a separate top-level window. Querying the main-window session can miss valid digit options and make this test flaky. Please switch the option lookup to a process-scoped session before asserting keys 0 through 9 are present.

proposed_comments.title: Fail fast when the WinEvent hook cannot start
proposed_comments.body:
### Fail fast when the WinEvent hook cannot start

**Severity:** `high`

`WindowShowWatcher` currently signals readiness even when `SetWinEventHook` fails, so callers get a watcher without an installed hook and later see a misleading timeout that looks like the product never showed the window. Please wait for hook startup and throw if the pump thread cannot install the hook or cannot become ready in time.

proposed_comments.title: Keep shared-scope settings snapshots until class cleanup
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep shared-scope settings snapshots until class cleanup

**Severity:** `high`

For test classes that opt into `ReuseScopeAcrossTests`, the first test's `Dispose()` runs while the shared PowerToys process intentionally stays alive. Restoring `settings.json` and `oobe_settings.json` at that point removes the configured module baseline for later tests in the same class. Please transfer the first-run settings snapshot to the shared scope and restore it from `StopSharedScope()` after the shared process is stopped.

proposed_comments.title: Move the Shortcut Guide build-target change out of this PR
proposed_comments.body:
### Move the Shortcut Guide build-target change out of this PR

**Severity:** `medium`

The `ShortcutGuide.Ui.csproj` MSB3030 workaround is unrelated to the FancyZones UI-test migration and product fixes described by this PR. PowerToys PRs should stay atomic so validation and ownership remain clear. Please move that project-file change to a separate Shortcut Guide PR, or remove it from this branch if it is no longer needed here.

proposed_comments.title: Update the PR description to include the editor .Next migration
proposed_comments.body:
### Update the PR description to include the editor .Next migration

**Severity:** `low`

The description says the main `FancyZones.UITests.Next` suite is being added and that editor CRUD coverage remains in the separate legacy editor project, but this diff also adds `FancyZonesEditor.UITests.Next` with extensive migrated editor coverage. Please update the summary and test counts so reviewers and CI expectations match the actual scope.
